description: Land Acquisition - Nambapona and Uragala, Ingiriya  D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for a public purpose. It includes descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4) for land acquisitions and related matters.
